scope: K03 pending-search cancellation and warning presentation; controlled HTTP/SSE fixtures only.

story.need: A stopped request must not claim a completed empty search.
acceptance: Show that the current search was stopped and incomplete.
Do not show empty results, prior actual mode or prior sources after cancellation.
A new search clears the stopped notice and can complete normally.

implementation: Cancellation has a separate visible incomplete state.
Only a successful non-aborted response marks searched=true.
A new search and library change clear the stopped state.
Legacy BM25 warning presentation accepts either whitespace form.

green.note: Restart-success assertions and a screenshot were added after initial RED; not claimed as separate REDs.

Search again: the notice clears and the completed results show their actual retrieval mode.
Switch libraries: no stopped notice from the previous library should remain.
